name: Doom Weed
summary: In Brill, Junior Apothecary Holland seeks doom weed for his research. The plant grows near Tirisfal's northern mass graves, where Rot Hide gnolls prowl.

sections.title: Apothecary Ambitions
sections.body: Junior Apothecary Holland researches for the Royal Apothecary Society from Brill. He wants doom weed to advance his experiments, but Gordo cannot tell the right plants from the wrong ones. Holland turns to more capable hands to gather what he needs.

sections.title: The Mass Grave Harvest
sections.body: Doom weed grows thick around the mass gravesite just north of the Brill graveyard, where death and plague have tainted the soil. Rot Hide gnolls prowl the burial mounds, scavenging among the remains and guarding the overgrown trenches.

faq.q: Why does Junior Apothecary Holland need doom weed?
faq.answer: Junior Apothecary Holland needs doom weed for his alchemical work with the Royal Apothecary Society. He says this work aids Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, though his eagerness also points to ambition within the society.

faq.q: Why doesn't Gordo gather the weeds himself?
faq.answer: Gordo is an abomination sent to gather herbs around Brill, but he cannot identify particular plants. After Gordo brings back the wrong weeds, Holland turns to capable adventurers.
Doom weed grows around the mass gravesite just north of the graveyard outside Brill. It spreads through soil tainted by burial trenches and lingering plague.

faq.q: What dangers lurk near the doom weed patches?
faq.answer: Rot Hide gnolls prowl the grounds around the mass gravesite. These feral, disease-ridden scavengers attack anyone who comes near while gathering the weeds.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society's interest in Tirisfal flora?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society studies plants, poisons, and blight-altered fungi across Tirisfal Glades. It gathers reagents like doom weed to refine toxins, seek alchemical cures, and develop weapons for the Forsaken against their enemies.

faq.q: Who is 'the Lady' mentioned by Holland?
faq.answer: “The Lady” means Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen and ruler of the Forsaken. Apothecaries in Undercity and Brill invoke her name, saying their alchemical work follows her command.

angles.text: As an undead, you may serve junior members of the Royal Apothecary Society as you establish your usefulness to Sylvanas's realm.
As a herbalist, you know the glades hold ordinary plants as well as corrupted growths like doom weed, shaped by the Scourge's plague.
As a member of the Horde, you see in Brill's unsettling alchemy how the Forsaken differ from their shamanic and nomadic allies in Kalimdor.
